guide.title: User Guide
guide.langToggle.label: Guide language
guide.quickStart.body: Select code in the editor, then use the context menu or Ctrl+Alt+E (Cmd+Alt+E on Mac). Review the explanation and complete the quiz.
guide.configureAi.body: Set apiBaseUrl and model in Code Explain settings, then configure an API Key. Secret Storage takes precedence over legacy settings and environment values.
guide.language.body: 1) Extension UI (commands, side bar, panels) follows the VS Code / Cursor display language. 2) AI explanation and grading text uses Settings → Code Explain → Output Language (codeExplain.outputLanguage: zh-CN or en-US). 3) This User Guide page can switch Chinese / English with the buttons at the top-right (page-only; does not change settings).
guide.features.body: Use Learning Progress to review mastery, Question Bank to revisit questions, Regression Test to practice weak topics, and Clear Progress to reset local learning data.
guide.troubleshooting.body: When an explanation fails, check the error toast and open Output → Code Explain for diagnostic details. Verify your network, API base URL, model, and API Key.
guide.notes.body: Your API Key is never sent to the Webview. This extension does not provide a Cursor floating toolbar.
